verify.note: same sim as verify.py and the published number

summary: Marksmanship 5/41/5 with Lone Wolf (+20% damage with no pet out). The hunter's default and best build. 44 DPS ahead of Marksmanship with a cat, because a Forever pet takes no player buffs.
rotation: Pre-pull: Aspect of the Hawk at -3s, Rapid Fire at -0.1s
Rapid Fire, racials, potions and Demonic Rune on cooldown
Arcane Shot on cooldown (above Aimed Shot, no mana floor)
Aimed Shot on the cooldown it shares with Multi-Shot
Scorpid Sting (2% off the boss's hit, 9% of base mana) at the pull and again in its last 2s, in place of Serpent Sting; the raid's Scorpid Sting is off
Sniper Shot on cooldown while mana >= 15 x seconds left
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets: 32 Agility and 14 crit rating, and an on-use 415 ranged attack power for 20s every 2 min (at the pull, then on cooldown).
Assumed fixed onto the rank curve: Trueshot Aura's top rank gives 100 ranged attack power and Hunter's Mark's 140. The client has 50 and 71, below the older ranks' 75 and 98.
Aspect of the Hawk stays at rank 5 (90 RAP) because Forever's rank 6 gives only 55.
Arcane Shot takes 10% of ranged attack power and Serpent Sting 3% a tick (Forever hunter wiki). The beta log fit was 11% and 3.5%.
Assumed: Auto Shot fires through casts with no 0.5s aim.
Wildstalker Armor 4-piece and 5-piece aren't in the preset (2-piece only). They would add 17.
Rapid Killing's +20% after a kill never triggers on a single boss.
Assumed: 22% more crit per Agility than Classic, the beta's level 1 ratio carried to 60.

The ranged weapon is a 2.5s bow at Rhok'delar's 44.0 DPS. A 2.6s gun sims 0.3 to 1.0 higher with a 15% ammo pouch, but 3.4 to 5.2 lower with Era Phase 1's 14% pouch (Ribbly's Bandolier). The 15% quiver takes only arrows.

Scorpid Sting duty: the raid's Scorpid Sting is off and the hunter keeps its own up in place of Serpent Sting. Costs 96.9 / 95.5 / 77.1 DPS at 120s / 180s / 300s against Lone Wolf, mostly Serpent Sting's damage.
The sting only lowers the boss's hit (2%, in the slot it shares with Insect Swarm, whose raid debuff stays on). It adds nothing to the raid's damage.

Windshaper is best (Wind Blessed, 3% haste since client 70425) at every fight length. On Lone Wolf and Marksmanship it is 1.2 to 1.6 ahead of High Order and 5 to 8 ahead of Night Elf. On Beast Mastery it is 0.3 to 0.9 ahead of Human.

Pet set to none (petType omitted = PetNone).
